full_track.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted chugging riffs and power chords. A high-gain lead guitar performs fast alternate-picked runs and wide vibrato. The bass guitar follows the root notes of the guitar riffs with a gritty, overdriven tone. Acoustic drums feature a punchy kick, a high-tuned snare, and frequent double-bass pedal patterns. The tempo is 140 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement alternates between dense rhythmic sections and melodic lead passages.
